generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The method `ignoreLons` uses `Arrays.stream(lons).anyMatch(v -> v == 180)` to check if any longitude value is exactly 180. This approach can be inefficient for large arrays due to the overhead of creating a stream and performing the match operation. Consider using a simple loop or `IntStream.range` for better performance.
